input: Draft a bucket list for my fortieth birthday year

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Bucket List for Your Fortieth Birthday Year
gold.taskDescription: Create a personalised bucket list of experiences, goals, and milestones to achieve during the year of the user's fortieth birthday.

questions.title: When exactly does your fortieth birthday fall?
questions.description: Knowing the specific date helps define the timeframe of the bucket list year.

questions.title: How many items do you want on the list?
questions.description: Understanding the desired length helps calibrate the scope of the bucket list.

questions.title: What broad categories matter most to you?
questions.description: For example: travel, fitness, relationships, career, creativity, or personal growth.

questions.title: Are there any big trips or destinations you have in mind?
questions.description: Travel items often require the most lead time and planning.

questions.title: What is your rough budget for the whole year?
questions.description: Budget shapes which experiences are realistic versus aspirational.

questions.title: Will you be doing these things solo or with others?
questions.description: Knowing whether a partner, family, or friends are involved affects what gets included.

questions.title: Are there fears or comfort zones you specifically want to push?
questions.description: Some people want deliberately challenging items; others prefer joyful and celebratory ones.
